lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome to Le Petit Bistro. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, we don't. A table for three, please.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Of course. Would you like still or sparkling water?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sparkling water, please. What do you recommend for dinner?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Our grilled chicken is very popular.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That sounds good. I'll have the grilled chicken, please.
